query: What is the maximum allowed API request payload size according to enterprise API gateway docs?
gold_answer: The maximum allowed API request payload size is 10 MB for standard REST endpoints, while streaming endpoints permit up to 50 MB [DOC-GATEWAY-101].

available_docs.text: Enterprise API Gateway specifies a maximum allowed API request payload size of 10 MB for standard REST endpoints. Streaming gRPC/WebSocket endpoints permit up to 50 MB payload buffer size.
Rate limits are set to 1000 requests per minute per tenant across all standard endpoints. Exceeding this returns HTTP 429.
Legacy v1 gateway allowed 5 MB payload size max. Deprecated as of Q3 2024.

query: Compare our SOC2 compliance data retention policy with GDPR right-to-be-forgotten requirements.
gold_answer: Under our SOC2 compliance policy, audit logs must be retained for at least 7 years for forensic auditing [DOC-SEC-201]. However, under GDPR Article 17, personal identifiable information (PII) must be erased within 30 days of request unless legal compliance supersedes [DOC-COMP-305].

available_docs.source_title: SOC2 Type II Audit & Log Retention Policy
available_docs.text: Security audit logs and access trace logs must be securely archived and retained for 7 years to satisfy SOC2 Type II compliance audit regulations.
GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure) mandates that PII data must be permanently erased from all production and backup stores within 30 calendar days upon receipt of a valid request.
All data at rest must be encrypted using AES-256 GCM algorithms with kms key rotation every 90 days.

query: Check the database status for cluster 'db-us-east-1' and summarize its current CPU utilization and primary node health.
gold_answer: Cluster 'db-us-east-1' is healthy with primary node 'db-us-east-1-primary' running at 42% CPU utilization and 0 active failover alerts [DOC-DB-OPS].

available_docs.text: Database metrics should be retrieved using the get_cluster_status tool. CPU thresholds above 80% require scaling alerts.

query: What is the recommended timeout setting for PostgreSQL connection pools in production?
gold_answer: According to the 2025 Production Runbook, PostgreSQL connection pool idle timeout must be set to 30 seconds [DOC-PG-PROD-2025]. Older 2021 recommendations of 300 seconds are deprecated.

available_docs.text: Idle connection timeout MUST be set to 30 seconds for all production pools to prevent connection starvation.
Set idle connection timeout to 300 seconds (5 minutes) for connection pools.
MySQL interactive timeout is set to 28800 seconds by default.

query: What is the policy for processing customer refunds for subscription cancellations?
gold_answer: Full refunds are issued within 14 days of subscription start. Partial pro-rated refunds apply after 14 days [DOC-REFUND-POL].

available_docs.text: Subscriptions cancelled within 14 days of purchase qualify for a 100% full refund. Cancellations past 14 days receive a pro-rated credit refund.
